_comment: Species on Screen — media/biodiversity collection pipeline. Editorial + operational configuration for scripts under research/sos_pipeline/. The harvester fills ONLY the core-metadata columns of the corpus schema (.agents/tasks/task-research-matrix/corpus-seed-framework.md §1.1) and the per-taxon identifier columns (§1.2). Every interpretive field (§1.5–§1.12) is left empty for a human coder, per .agents/tasks/task-pilot-execution/coding-workspace-spec.md §17. Paths are relative to research/.
_authority: corpus-seed-framework.md is authoritative for the schema; coding-workspace-spec.md is authoritative for the flattened columns, artefact-id format, coding states and the manual boundary; SENSITIVE-DATA-POLICY.md is authoritative for locality generalisation. This file configures; it does not legislate. Where this file and one of those disagree, the source wins.

corpus._workspace_root_note: The corpus and the Paper 1 instrument live in the private repository tarunv13/species-on-screen-research; this repository is public and holds only the code. The path here assumes that repo is checked out beside this one. It is machine-specific, so set SOS_WORKSPACE_ROOT in .env to override it — the environment variable wins. Without either, the read-only commands (doctor, plan, registry --print-postgres-ddl) still work; anything that writes a corpus row will tell you the workspace is missing.

seed._landscape_ids_note: Empty list = all 24 landscapes in the registry. Name ids to narrow a run.

ethics._min_creator_audience_note: §8.3 — creators below this follower/subscriber count are excluded by default (consent-or-opt-out territory). Raise or lower deliberately; every exclusion is counted in the run's sampling-frame report.
ethics._collect_comments_note: §8.4 / §8.8 — audience comments are human-subject data. Off unless a study needs them and ethics review covers them.
ethics._collect_content_files_note: §8.1 — metadata is universally collectable; content files are not collected by this pipeline under any flag.
ethics._algorithmic_sampling_note: §8.5 — no personalised/recommendation-mediated sampling. Queries are explicit and logged.
ethics._coordinate_note: SENSITIVE-DATA-POLICY.md — coordinates are generalised before they are written and never committed at source precision.

youtube._quota_note: search.list has its own bucket: 100 calls/day, 1 unit each. Every other list method costs 1 unit against the 10,000/day pool. Enumerating a channel's uploads playlist (playlistItems.list) is therefore ~100x cheaper than searching; prefer seed channels over discovery.
youtube._seed_channel_ids_note: Channel ids (UC...) enumerated via their uploads playlist. Cheap, reproducible, and not algorithmically mediated — the preferred sampling frame.

meta_content_library._mode_note: 'import' (default, outside the enclave): read a vetted export the researcher carried out of the secure environment. 'enclave': run inside Meta's Secure Research Environment or ICPSR's SOMAR Virtual Data Enclave, where metacontentlibraryapi is importable. There is no third mode; the API cannot be reached from a personal machine.

iucn_get._typology_note: Download the Ecosystem Functional Group table from https://global-ecosystems.org/explore (typology v2.1; Keith et al. 2022, doi:10.1038/s41586-022-05318-4) and save it here with columns realm_code, realm_name, biome_code, biome_name, efg_code, efg_name. If the file is absent, ecosystem bindings stay UNRESOLVED — they are never guessed.

wayback._save_note: coding-workspace-spec.md §17 lists Save Page Now clicks as manual. This pipeline checks availability only and emits a capture worklist; it never submits a save.
